objects.description: During [C0033](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0033), [PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056) used [StrongPity](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0491) to communicate with the C2 server using HTTPS.(Citation: welivesec_strongpity)
